trace.selection_rule: Only the completed ranges specified by the phase manifest; later trace appends are excluded. Byte offsets are zero-based, start-inclusive and end-exclusive.

conditions.process: Fresh release app process opened only this rich fixture. History, immutable-file, staged and unstaged phases ran in that order.
conditions.cache: OS caches were not flushed or otherwise controlled. One retained repository/object reader. Return immutable file selections may use the 32-entry content cache. Staged and unstaged previews bypass that immutable cache. Initial activations and setup callbacks are retained separately and excluded from navigation statistics.
conditions.other_load: No build, tests, backend benchmark or other native interaction ran during timing except the recorded inputs. Other desktop applications remained open; OS background activity was uncontrolled.
conditions.git_writes: No Git writes were performed during these measurements.
conditions.sample_policy: Twenty deliberate inputs and twenty measured callbacks per series; no additional warmup series. Retain every measured outlier.

percentiles: Nearest rank over each 20-sample measured series; p50 is sorted rank 10, p95 rank 19, maximum rank 20. No measured outliers discarded.
boundary: Application selection/activation handler through the generation- and mode-checked GPUI callback after metadata or preview preparation; excludes input delivery before the handler, OS display presentation and completed GPU execution. Working preview frames exclude preceding status refresh or Git writes.

preservation.verification: Post-phase read-only comparison of full path inventory, kind, byte size, SHA-256 and mtime_ns against the baseline. Regular files opened NOFOLLOW; symlinks hashed as stored target text.
preservation.excluded: Immutable .git/objects storage, access times and directory metadata. The check is a before/after observation, not proof of atomic isolation during the run.

limits: Small uncontrolled native samples on one local fixture and one macOS host, not a comparative speedup, physical click-to-display measurement, latency guarantee or platform-wide result. No image decoding, writes, watcher latency, cancellation latency or memory-growth measurement.
